questions.q: In which year was the United Arab Emirates founded?
questions.why: The union was declared on 2 December 1971.

questions.q: Who was the UAE's founding President?
questions.a: Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan
wrong: Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum
questions.why: He is called the Father of the Nation.

questions.q: On what date is UAE National Day?
questions.why: It is also called Eid Al Etihad.

questions.q: How many emirates make up the UAE?
questions.why: Abu Dhabi is the largest.

questions.q: Which emirate joined the union in 1972, a few months after the others?
questions.why: It joined in February 1972.

questions.q: Before oil, what was the main industry along the coast?
questions.why: Cultured pearls from Japan ended the trade in the 1930s.

questions.q: Who became President of the UAE in 2022?
questions.why: He succeeded Sheikh Khalifa.

questions.q: Which ruler of Dubai is also the UAE's Vice President and Prime Minister?
questions.a: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum
wrong: Sheikh Sultan bin Muhammad Al Qasimi
questions.why: He has ruled Dubai since 2006.

questions.q: What were the coastal sheikhdoms under British protection called before 1971?
questions.why: The name came from truces signed with Britain.

questions.q: In which year did Abu Dhabi first export oil?
questions.why: It was shipped from Das Island.

questions.q: Which fort is Dubai's oldest existing building?
questions.why: It was built around 1787.

questions.q: Which UAE city's oases and ancient tombs are a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
questions.why: It is called the Garden City.

questions.q: What is marked on 30 November each year?
questions.why: It honours Emirati martyrs.

questions.q: Mleiha, with finds over 100,000 years old, is in which emirate?
questions.why: Stone tools found there are among the oldest in Arabia.

questions.q: In which year did Expo 2020 Dubai actually open?
questions.why: It was delayed by the pandemic but kept its name.

questions.q: Who became the first Emirati in space, in 2019?
questions.why: Sultan Al Neyadi later did a six-month mission.

questions.q: What is the capital of the UAE?
questions.why: It is on an island.

questions.q: Which Dubai skyscraper is the tallest building in the world?
questions.why: It opened in 2010.

questions.q: Which is the UAE's most populous city?
questions.why: Most of its people are expatriates.

questions.q: Which artificial island in Dubai is shaped like a palm tree?
questions.why: Atlantis hotel sits at its tip.

questions.q: Which is the largest of the seven emirates?
questions.why: It covers over 80% of the country.

questions.q: Which two countries border the UAE?
questions.why: Qatar lies across the water.

questions.q: Which hotel in Dubai is shaped like a sail?
questions.why: It stands on its own island.

questions.q: What is the UAE's highest peak?
questions.why: It is in Ras Al Khaimah and has a record zipline.

questions.q: Which emirate lies entirely on the Gulf of Oman coast?
questions.why: The others face the Persian Gulf.

questions.q: Which waterway divides old Dubai into Deira and Bur Dubai?
questions.why: Abras ferry people across it.

questions.q: Which is the smallest emirate?
questions.why: It covers about 260 km².

questions.q: On which island is the Louvre Abu Dhabi?
questions.why: Saadiyat means 'island of happiness'.

questions.q: Which oasis on the edge of the Empty Quarter has some of the world's highest dunes?
questions.why: Moreeb Dune is about 300 m high.

questions.q: Which mountain near Al Ain has a winding road to its summit?
questions.why: It is the UAE's second-highest peak.

questions.q: Which strait lies at the mouth of the Persian Gulf near the UAE?
questions.why: Much of the world's oil passes through it.

questions.q: Which island is a wildlife reserve with Arabian oryx and cheetahs?
questions.why: Sheikh Zayed made it a reserve in 1971.

questions.q: Which Formula One race is held at Yas Marina?
questions.why: It is often the last race of the season.

questions.q: Which horse race in Dubai is among the richest in the world?
questions.why: The prize fund is about US$12 million.

questions.q: Which traditional animal race now often uses robot jockeys?
questions.why: Robots replaced child jockeys in the 2000s.

questions.q: Which bird is used in the traditional sport of falconry?
questions.why: Abu Dhabi even has a falcon hospital.

questions.q: Which global cricket body has its headquarters in Dubai?
questions.why: It moved there from London in 2005.

questions.q: Which tennis tournament is held in Dubai every February?
questions.why: Roger Federer won it eight times.

questions.q: Which golf tournament ends the DP World Tour season?
questions.why: It is played at Jumeirah Golf Estates.

questions.q: Who won the UAE's first Olympic gold, in shooting in 2004?
questions.a: Sheikh Ahmed bin Hasher Al Maktoum
questions.why: He won the double trap in Athens.

questions.q: Which Al Ain club won the AFC Champions League in 2024?
questions.why: It was their second Asian title.

questions.q: Which cyclist has won the Tour de France for UAE Team Emirates?
questions.why: He is from Slovenia.

questions.q: Which racecourse hosts the Dubai World Cup?
questions.why: It opened in 2010.

questions.q: Which traditional wooden boats race in UAE heritage regattas?
questions.why: They were once used for pearling and trade.

questions.q: Which slender hunting dog is part of Emirati tradition?
questions.why: Bedouins used them to hunt gazelles.

questions.q: Which martial art is taught in Abu Dhabi schools and hosts world championships there?
questions.why: Abu Dhabi calls itself a jiu-jitsu capital.

questions.q: In which year did the UAE most recently host the AFC Asian Cup?
questions.why: Qatar won the tournament.

questions.q: Which footballer, nicknamed 'Amoory', was 2016 Asian Footballer of the Year?
questions.why: He played for Al Ain.

questions.q: What is the traditional long white robe worn by Emirati men called?
questions.why: It is also called a dishdasha.

questions.q: What is the black cloak worn by many Emirati women called?
questions.why: The headscarf is called a sheila.

questions.q: Which traditional Emirati dance uses canes and drums?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's heritage list.

questions.q: Which museum opened on Saadiyat Island in 2017?
questions.why: It has a huge dome that filters light.

questions.q: In which city is the Museum of the Future?
questions.why: Its walls are covered in Arabic calligraphy.

questions.q: What is traditional Arabic coffee called in the UAE?
questions.why: It is spiced with cardamom.

questions.q: Which stringed instrument is central to Gulf music?
questions.why: It is pear-shaped and has no frets.

questions.q: Which Emirati singer is famous for 'Boshret Kheir'?
questions.why: The song encouraged Egyptians to vote.

questions.q: Which form of Bedouin poetry is popular in the UAE?
questions.why: It is written in local Arabic.

questions.q: Which TV poetry competition from Abu Dhabi is watched across the Arab world?
questions.why: Contestants recite Nabati poems.

questions.q: Which emirate was named UNESCO World Book Capital in 2019?
questions.why: It hosts a huge international book fair.

questions.q: Which architect designed the Louvre Abu Dhabi?
questions.why: Its dome is 180 m wide.

questions.q: Which shopping festival, started in 1996, is held every winter?
questions.why: It brings raffles and fireworks.

questions.q: Which fort is the oldest stone building in Abu Dhabi city?
questions.why: It was the ruling family's home.

questions.q: Which seasonal cultural park in Dubai has pavilions from many countries?
questions.why: It is open from October to April.

questions.q: Which Emirati heritage art is the weaving of Bedouin textiles?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's heritage list.

questions.q: Which fruit is a staple of Emirati hospitality?
questions.why: They are served with gahwa.

questions.q: Which spiced rice dish with meat is a favourite Emirati meal?
questions.why: Dried lime gives it a sour note.

questions.q: Which sweet fried dumplings are drizzled with date syrup?
questions.why: They are popular during Ramadan.

questions.q: What is the meal that breaks the fast in Ramadan called?
questions.why: Suhoor is the meal before dawn.

questions.q: What is bakhoor?
questions.a: Scented wood chips burned as incense
questions.why: It is burned to welcome guests.

questions.q: Which plant dye is used for decorative patterns on hands at celebrations?
questions.why: It is popular before Eid and weddings.

questions.q: Which animal's milk is sold in the UAE as chocolate and ice cream?
questions.why: Camel milk is lower in fat than cow's milk.

questions.q: Which dish of wheat and meat is cooked slowly for Ramadan and Eid?
questions.why: It is slow-cooked for hours until smooth.

questions.q: What is a majlis?
questions.a: A sitting room for receiving guests
questions.why: Majlis culture is on UNESCO's heritage list.

questions.q: Which market in Deira is famous for jewellery?
questions.why: Shops display tonnes of gold.

questions.q: Which traditional hunting practice is on UNESCO's heritage list with UAE support?
questions.why: The UAE led the 2010 nomination.

questions.q: What are the small handleless cups for gahwa called?
questions.why: The pot is called a dallah.

questions.q: Which sweet vermicelli dish is topped with an omelette?
questions.why: It is a traditional breakfast.

questions.q: Which festival in the Western Region holds a camel beauty contest?
questions.why: Prizes run into millions of dirhams.

questions.q: Which braided embroidery, made with silver thread, is an Emirati craft?
questions.why: It decorates the collars and cuffs of clothing.

questions.q: What is 'arish'?
questions.a: Palm-frond building material for summer houses
questions.why: Arish houses let the breeze through.

questions.q: What is the UAE's currency?
questions.why: It is pegged to the US dollar.

questions.q: What is the UAE's official language?
questions.why: English is widely used in business.

questions.q: What colours are on the UAE flag?
questions.why: They are the Pan-Arab colours.

questions.q: What is the UAE's national bird?
questions.why: It appears on the coat of arms.

questions.q: Which airline is based in Abu Dhabi?
questions.why: Emirates is based in Dubai.

questions.q: Which huge white mosque in Abu Dhabi is named after the founding President?
questions.why: It has one of the world's largest carpets.

questions.q: What was the name of the UAE's mission that reached Mars orbit in 2021?
questions.why: It was the first Arab mission to Mars.

questions.q: What is the UAE's national animal?
questions.why: It was saved from extinction in the wild.

questions.q: What is the UAE's national anthem called?
questions.why: It means 'Long live my country'.

questions.q: In 2022 the UAE moved its weekend to which days?
questions.why: Friday became a half working day.

questions.q: Which city has a driverless metro, opened in 2009?
questions.why: It was the first metro in the Gulf.

questions.q: Which planned city in Abu Dhabi focuses on clean energy?
questions.why: IRENA has its headquarters there.

questions.q: What is the UAE's consultative federal assembly called?
questions.why: Half its members are elected.

questions.q: Which nuclear power plant was the first in the Arab world?
questions.why: Its first unit began operating in 2020.

questions.q: How tall is the Burj Khalifa?
questions.why: It has over 160 floors.

questions.q: What is the Expo 2020 site called today?
questions.why: Its Al Wasl dome still hosts events.
